authorization: latest user pasted method request; package development policy adopted without scientific formula changes

scope.classification: OPEN method development CV, not fresh confirmation

encoding.positive_thresholds: pooled training-only 1/3 and2/3 quantiles across sources/protocols/times
encoding.ties: unique thresholds merge identical intervals; one alphabet shared by all arms

channel.interpretation: common total Dirichlet pseudocount1; statistical smoothing, not sensor noise or posterior floor

selection.shared_and_independent: independent model-wide selection, same inner CV/mean log score policy
selection.tie_break: smallest rho; temperature nearest1 then smaller T, within1e-12 mean nats
selection.shuffle: same selected shared rho; no separate hyperparameter search

identity_ablation.policy: protocol0 unchanged; for each source/protocol>0 sort reference run IDs by domain-separated SHA256

solver.objective: maximize conditional entropy under per-source KL weights; same as supplied SLSQP prototype
solver.implementation: sparse-channel entropic mirror ascent with KL-Bregman projection and independent KL dual risk certificate

endpoint: per-source mean over16runs and60protocols of paired log2 truth probability gain

bootstrap.interpretation: OPEN crossfit source-panel sensitivity interval, not fresh/generalization coverage

retention_rule.primary: shared gains over nominal/independent/temperature each>0 and source-panel95% lower>0
retention_rule.ablation: shared gain over identity-shuffled comparator>0 and95% lower>0
retention_rule.effect_size_and_cost_reported: no claim that an arbitrarily tiny positive gain establishes a main innovation
retention_rule.secondary_metrics: Brier/rank/distance/tails descriptive, cannot rescue primary comparison

rank: deterministic ties by ascending candidate index, no optimistic tie ranks
